scientific_scope: Loss equations and legacy numerical stabilizers are preserved. NIG pi now follows input precision/device. Previously silent class-weight omission, invalid labels and invalid concentrations are corrected/rejected. Gradient accumulation and metrics now honor sample/criterion denominators. Prior uncertainty corrections implement population finite-mixture law of total variance and exact affine variance scaling, with analytical tests.
limitations: No native macOS/Windows execution here; CI workflow is the delivery mechanism for those platforms.
No actual CUDA AMP, accelerator FSDP or CPU Gloo collectives executed. Mocked API routing is explicitly marked.
Multi-rank Trainer and application execution is explicitly unsupported until global metrics, weighted gradient synchronization and sampler-padding deduplication are implemented and tested.
BatchNorm training on a singleton minibatch remains a native PyTorch restriction; use an appropriate batch size or disable batch normalization.
LipschitzMSELoss.tol is a legacy unused argument, now documented. Its batch-dependent modified-MSE coefficient intentionally remains unchanged.

Training/validate methods return per-minibatch diagnostics; fit validation and predict compute dataset-level nonlinear metrics. Per-minibatch training metrics are diagnostics, not globally recomputed epoch estimators.
Generic non-evidential classifiers are assumed to output logits unless they declare mc_output_kind="probabilities".
Default public init_weights(init_gain=0.0) is preserved; DNN(weight_init=True) explicitly uses Kaiming initialization.
Function coverage means executed statements, not proof of all possible inputs or absence of errors.
changes: load_scheduler unwraps library optimizer wrappers before native PyTorch scheduler construction.
FSDP checkpoint calls receive the native model and optimizer and explicitly request full optimizer state for unsharded saves.
Checkpoint executable example supplies required rank arguments.
Distributed wrapper accepts pathlib save locations, expands home paths, rejects CPU FSDP before optional imports, and resolves an unspecified CUDA index to the current device.

Explicit cosine step(epoch) follows the existing rounded warmup-excluding recurrence used by incremental step(), including backward epoch resets. Invalid shrinking/zero-length schedules are rejected before division by zero.
Unequal microbatches accumulate sample-weighted or weighted-CE gradients; sum-reduced losses are summed, and cosine scheduling advances on optimizer updates.
CPU inputs follow model floating dtype; one-target regression accepts vector labels without broadcasting; class labels validate integer/range semantics.
Classifier metrics/prediction outputs use probabilities; validation metrics in fit are computed over all selected validation samples rather than averaged minibatch nonlinear scores.

Trainer retains forward wrappers, saves underlying unprefixed model state, preserves sampler epoch changes, min/max best-metric selection, finite-value handling and resumed-epoch early-stopping offsets.
Direct multi-rank training fails explicitly, rank-zero owns logs and metadata writes, initialized FSDP device/offload placement is preserved, and inputs honor explicit compute device.
Spectral initialization changes weight_orig after a forward pass; parameterless buffered models preserve floating dtype; nonfinite categorical evidence is rejected.
EDL class weights supplied as lists/arrays now take effect exactly as tensor weights; invalid annealing and Dirichlet inputs fail explicitly.
NIG marginal-likelihood pi uses input precision/device; tol documentation now accurately states its legacy unused role.
